question: Which of the following solution has the lowest pH value?
solution:
The correct answer is '**Tomato juice'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **pH-value** defines the **acidity** or **basicity** of the substance. More the** acidic substance** lower is the **acidic value**.
 
• **pH-value** helps us to know whether the substance is** acidic **or **basic.**
 
• Its value ranges from** 0-14**.
 
• **0-6.9 **is considered as an acidic substance,** 7** is considered as neutral and** 7.1** to **14** is considered as basic.
 
• **Tomato**: Tomato contains two types of acids, these are malic acid and citric acid. Both of them are mild acids. Hence the** pH-value** of tomato ranges from** 3.5-4.7.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The **pH of saliva before the meal** is about **7.4 **which is basic. The **pH of saliva after the meal **is around** 5 **.
 
• *Coffee* does indeed have a pH level, but is not a useful measure of flavor. It would vary depending on brewing method and roast level, but not significantly. Black coffee generally lands around a pH of** 5 (acidic, not basic) **and** milk** has a** pH of 6** (slightly more neutral).
